overall_reason: A deploy list with useful context ('PRODUCTION · 3 DEPLOYS') where every label, name and time is set in tracked capitals.

score.reason: T-SIGNATURE passes on the rows; T-MIRROR and T-DEFAULT-AGENT hold because all-caps tracked labels are a stock developer-tool look, and T-BOLD-MOVE is diluted when every label is styled as a heading.

findings.title: No look picked for the category or by default
findings.where: heading, button, meta and timestamps, 1440 and 375
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png 'RECENT DEPLOYS', 'DEPLOY', 'PRODUCTION · 3 DEPLOYS', 'MAIN · MAYA CHEN', 'JUST NOW' and '12M AGO' are all tracked capitals; only the deploy names are in sentence case.
findings.before: Tracked capitals on six kinds of text, including a person's name and times.
findings.after: Keep capitals for one label level at most; set names, branches and times in sentence case.
findings.why: The style is applied by default to everything, so it marks nothing.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png the failed deploy is marked only by a small red icon; no word says it failed.
findings.before: Failure shown by an icon only.
findings.after: Add a status word next to the icon.
findings.why: The row that needs action is easy to miss.

strengths: The sub-line 'PRODUCTION · 3 DEPLOYS' names the environment, which most deploy lists leave out.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
